description: This file provides utility functions to generate a User-Agent string based on the operating system, environment, and embedder information for the Playwright project.

methods.name: getUserAgent
methods.description: Returns a cached or newly determined User-Agent string based on OS and environment.

methods.name: determineUserAgent
methods.description: Constructs the User-Agent string based on OS type, version, and environment variables.

methods.name: getEmbedderName
methods.description: Returns the name and version of the embedder environment (e.g., Node, Python).

methods.name: getPlaywrightVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the Playwright version, optionally only major and minor parts.
